record.action:
Concurrent capped responses
Against the same real-database round-2/event-count snapshot, issue two capped responses concurrently.
record.conditions:
Two capped responses read the same owned round-2/event-count snapshot, released by a barrier.
Real isolated MongoDB; deterministic provider/call instrumentation.
record.expectedResult: at most one event append succeeds; no provider call/adaptation; round remains 2; losing operation is controlled conflict.
record.actualResult:
exactly one success and one controlled conflict; round/adaptations stay 2; events total 3
Provider calls during action: 0; persistence: 2 attempts; 1 atomic event write.
record.limitation: Same-snapshot capped-response contention only; no general workload guarantee.

record.note: one capped event persisted; one controlled conflict
